vikisozluk_etimolojiler.metin: From Old East Slavic Русь (Rusĭ). Compare Medieval Greek Ῥῶς (Rhôs), English Rus, German Russe or Russian Русь (Rusʹ).

Proto-Afroasiatic
Proto-Semitic
Arabic ـِيّ (-iyy)
Arabic روسي
From رُوس (rūs, “Russians”) + ـِيّ (-iyy).
See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
